request.style: English, female solo voice, warm and reflective, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft drums, hopeful and solemn mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Prophets came down to Antioch town
From Jerusalem where the story's known
One stood up named Agabus there
By the Spirit he made a declaration

[Pre-Chorus]
A severe famine over the whole world
In the days of Claudius it unfurled

[Chorus]
He warned of the hunger that would come
He warned of the binding to be done
The Spirit spoke through the prophet’s voice
To show the path of the man’s choice

[Verse]
Disciples decided to send relief
Each according to their ability
To brothers living in Judea’s land
Barnabas and Saul carried the plan

[Pre-Chorus]
Then in Caesarea the days went by
A prophet came down from Judea nigh

[Chorus]
He warned of the hunger that would come
He warned of the binding to be done
The Spirit spoke through the prophet’s voice
To show the path of the man’s choice

[Verse]
At Philip’s house he took Paul’s belt
Tied his own hands and feet by the text
Said the Jews in Jerusalem would bind
The man who owns this belt is signed

[Pre-Chorus]
They begged him not to go up there
But Paul stood firm in the air

[Chorus]
He warned of the hunger that would come
He warned of the binding to be done
The Spirit spoke through the prophet’s voice
To show the path of the man’s choice

[Bridge]
Why are you weeping and breaking my heart
I am ready to be bound apart
Even to die for the Lord Jesus name
In Jerusalem I do not shame

[Outro]
The Lord’s will be done we said
The belt tied the prophecy ahead
